name: BillDogEng
summary: BillDog iOS SDK (Engagement) — auth, analytics, surveys, A/B testing, messaging, replay.
description:
Binary distribution of the engagement-only BillDog iOS SDK: auth (password,
codes, passkeys, MFA, organizations and social sign-in with Apple, Google and
Facebook), analytics, A/B testing and feature flags, notifications, in-app
messages, session replay and surveys, plus observe-only recording of the
StoreKit purchases the app makes itself — without paywalls, an SDK-driven
purchase flow, or the WebView paywall renderer. Ships as a precompiled
xcframework; import the single `BillDogEng` module.
